issues.detail: The instructions do not explicitly cover error handling for missing environment variables or network failures.

scenarios.name: rate-limit-api-route
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most rubric items but uses a user ID instead of IP and returns a different JSON body; Response B lacks the required Redis, sliding window, and header logic entirely.
